== Trivia ==
* Although he is a Necromancer, his unique drop is a [[sword]].
** Nonetheless, it is a [[Caster_weapon#Martial_sets|caster weapon]] (that provides +5 energy and +20% enchantment duration), which does synergize with his elite skill.
* He uses either his unique weapon or a [[Wicked Blade]] in melee combat.
